basic_details.job_title: NITI Aayog Library and Information Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog), Admin-IV Section has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Library and Information Officer on a deputation basis, requiring offline applications to be sent through proper channel to the Admin-IV Section, NITI Aayog, New Delhi on or before 8 December 2026. Eligible candidates applying for the post must hold a Master Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science. The notified pay for this position is Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700/-).

Master Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications and Experience: Master Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science from a recognised University or Institute. Five years' professional experience in a library under the Central Government or State Government or Union territory Administration or Autonomous or Statutory organisation or Public Sector Undertaking or University or Recognised Research or Educational Institution. Desirable Qualifications and Experience: Diploma in Computer Application from a recognised University or Institute. One year experience of computerising library activities in a library under Central Government or State Government or Autonomous or Statutory organisation or Public Sector Undertaking or University or Recognised Research or Educational Institution. Eligibility by Deputation / Promotion Method: Officers of Central Government or State Governments or Union territories Administration or Statutory Organisation or Autonomous Organisation or Public Sector Undertaking or recognized University or recognized research Institution holding analogous posts on a regular basis; or with five years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in level 10 of the pay matrix; or with seven years' service in level 9; or with eight years' in level 8; or with nine years' service in level 7; and possessing the essential educational qualifications and experience. Age Limit: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short-term contract) shall not exceed fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of educational qualifications and experience (self-attested) Original/attested photocopies of the APARs for the last 5 years Vigilance clearance certificate Integrity Certificate No Major/Minor penalty certificate for last 10 years

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for NITI Aayog Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to reach the application through proper channel is 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Library and Information Officer post?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-11 with a pay scale of Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700/- in the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science from a recognised University or Institute along with five years' professional experience in a qualifying library.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be attached with the offline application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose self-attested proof of educational qualifications and experience, original or attested photocopies of APARs for the last 5 years, a vigilance clearance certificate, an Integrity Certificate, and a No Major/Minor penalty certificate for the last 10 years.
